## Retention source review

The source notes under `docs/reference/requirements/sources/` are evidence, not an
automatic contract replacement. `policy-v1.md` is the reviewed signed
agreement; `policy-v2.md` is a later candidate proposal with a conflicting
retention value.

Use the complex-domain recipe seams around the `RequirementSource` and
`Requirement` anchors to inspect affected context. Keep the `DomainProcess`
and `UserWorkflow` notes distinct, preserve the frozen spec, and record a
review commitment instead of inventing a business decision.
